sections.text_helper: Section 67.4.3 "SPI communication general aspects" in chapter 67 (Serial peripheral interface (SPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3430.
sections.section_content:
The SPI allows the MCU to communicate using different configurations, depending on the
device targeted and the application requirements. These configurations use two or three
wires (with software slave select management) or three or four wires (with hardware slave
select management). The communication is always initiated and controlled by the master.
The master provides a clock signal on the SCK line and selects or synchronizes slaves for
communication by NSS line when it is managed by hardware.
The data between the master and the slave flow synchronously on the MOSI and/or MISO
lines.
